iran_nuclear.name: IRAN NUCLEAR
iran_nuclear.notes: Iran talks remain live, but the enriched-uranium removal red line and inspection-continuity risk keep breakout concern elevated; no verified higher-level jump or device event surfaced.

iran_conventional.name: IRAN WAR
iran_conventional.notes: Fresh RFE/RL, CBC, Al Jazeera and maritime reporting describe new US-Iran strikes, Iranian retaliation and merchant ships avoiding Hormuz. Talks are still present, but Gulf-route risk is acute.

israel_lebanon.name: ISRAEL-LEBANON
israel_lebanon.notes: BBC, Reuters, PBS, France24, Guardian and CBC report southern Lebanon evacuation orders, an expanded combat zone, Israeli strikes and Hezbollah fighting; the post-truce channel is deteriorating.

turkey.name: TURKEY
turkey.notes: Fresh Turkey results frame Ankara as a limited regional spillover actor in the Iran crisis; no authoritative strategic warning, weapons demonstration, or NATO crisis trigger surfaced.

india.name: INDIA-PAKISTAN
india.notes: India-Pakistan vigilance is slightly above baseline after border-demolition reporting and renewed nuclear-flashpoint commentary, while China-linked peace analysis and no verified force surge keep escalation contained.

russia.name: RUSSIA-NATO
russia.notes: European officials again warn Moscow may expand the war beyond Ukraine and Kremlin-aligned nuclear warning language persists; no confirmed direct NATO clash surfaced.

china.name: CHINA-TAIWAN
china.notes: Taiwan Strait pressure remains elevated by recent Pratas/coast-guard friction and reports of large vessel activity near Taiwan, but the Pratas ship withdrawal and no fresh blockade/direct clash cap the move.

north_korea.name: NORTH KOREA
north_korea.notes: USNI, France24, Reuters and AP report North Korean tests of new launch systems, tactical cruise missiles, AI-guided missiles and artillery rockets; no device-event evidence surfaced.

russia_ukraine.name: RUSSIA-UKRAINE
russia_ukraine.notes: WSJ, CBS, Kyiv Post, ynet and i24 report expanded-war warnings, Russian threats of systematic Kyiv strikes and NATO preparation concerns; this remains the highest raw driver.

pakistan_afghanistan.name: PAKISTAN-AFGHANISTAN
pakistan_afghanistan.notes: Afghanistan International and regional feeds describe continued Pakistan-Taliban accusations and border-fighting stalemate, while Moscow/Urumqi-process mediation keeps deconfliction channels alive.

sudan.name: SUDAN
sudan.notes: Sudan remains critical from the continuing SAF-RSF drone/infrastructure-strike pattern and external-backing allegations, but today’s fresh RSS scan produced no new Port Sudan-scale trigger.

israel_palestine.name: ISRAEL-PALESTINE
israel_palestine.notes: Gaza/Jerusalem risk remains critical: fresh items say Israel killed a new Hamas military leader and strikes continue while ceasefire/hostage-deal optimism remains unresolved.

south_sudan_abyei.name: SOUTH SUDAN-ABYEI
south_sudan_abyei.notes: South Sudan/Abyei remains elevated on carried UNISFA/Abyei warning conditions and unauthorized-force concerns; no fresh 24h escalation item surfaced.

latest_news.headline: Merchant ships avoid Hormuz as US-Iran strikes continue
latest_news.text: RFE/RL, CBC, Al Jazeera and gCaptain report new US defensive strikes, Iranian retaliation and merchant ships deserting Hormuz routes.

latest_news.headline: Israel expands southern Lebanon combat zone
latest_news.text: BBC, Reuters, PBS, France24 and Guardian report evacuation orders, southern Lebanon strikes and Hezbollah fighting.

latest_news.headline: Europe warns Russia may expand war beyond Ukraine
latest_news.text: WSJ, CBS, Kyiv Post, ynet and i24 report expanded-war warnings and threats of systematic Kyiv strikes.

latest_news.headline: DPRK tests new launchers and guided missiles
latest_news.text: USNI, France24, Reuters and AP report new launch-system, tactical cruise missile, AI-guided missile and artillery-rocket tests.

latest_news.headline: Russia-NATO risk held by expanded-war and nuclear warnings
latest_news.text: Kyiv Post, Al Jazeera and London Business News carry European expanded-war concern and Kremlin nuclear warning language.

latest_news.headline: Iran enriched-uranium removal red line persists
latest_news.text: Al Jazeera, Haaretz and Times of India-linked reporting show talks continuing while Tehran-linked voices reject removing enriched uranium abroad.

latest_news.headline: Pakistan-Afghanistan tensions remain in mediation channel
latest_news.text: Afghanistan International, Dawn and Khaama Press report Taliban accusations and border tension alongside Moscow/Urumqi-process mediation.

latest_news.headline: Taiwan pressure elevated, Pratas standoff not renewed
latest_news.text: GTI, Taipei Times, Marine News and Indian Express reporting point to continued pressure but also a Chinese ship withdrawal near Pratas.

latest_news.headline: India-Pakistan vigilance lifted but contained
latest_news.text: Border-demolition reporting and nuclear-flashpoint commentary lift vigilance, while peace-process analysis and no verified force surge keep risk contained.

latest_news.headline: Turkey remains limited spillover actor
latest_news.text: Washington Institute reporting frames Turkey as constrained in the Iran-war spillover picture; no fresh NATO crisis trigger surfaced.
